title: Pamukkale, Turkey
author: NASA/METI/AIST/Japan Space Systems, and U.S./Japan ASTER Science Team
description: In western Turkey, Pamukkale travertine pools and terraces form the largest such complex in the world. For thousands of years, people have visited the area due to the attraction of the thermal pools. The ancient Greco-Roman city of Hierapolis was built on top of the travertine formation.
